episode_title: Voice, Value, and AI: Unlocking Employee Ideas to Transform Culture and Drive Action

real_qa.q: What percentage of good employee ideas does research show get withheld from managers?
real_qa.r: In surveys of financial service institutions with about 3,000 responses to open-ended comments that were rated by senior executive teams for novelty, feasibility, and value, approximately 60 percent of the top 100 rated ideas were withheld and not told to the immediate boss. Additionally, general surveys show that about 80 percent of employees routinely withhold some of the ideas and feedback they have.

real_qa.q: How much turnover reduction did managers responsive to employee voice achieve at a national restaurant chain?
real_qa.r: At a national restaurant chain experiencing about 180 percent turnover per year, there was a delta of about 30 to 40 percent in turnover rates between general managers who were most responsive to employee voice compared to those who were least responsive to their employees.
real_qa.requete: restaurant chain turnover reduction employee voice

real_qa.q: What revenue impact did employee voice have at an organization that connected it with sales performance?
real_qa.r: In an organization where voice was connected with sales, there was a difference of about 10 to 15 percent in actual revenue generated from employees based on their ability to convey their ideas to their managers who could take action on them.

real_qa.q: Why might AI chatbots alone not solve psychological safety barriers to employee feedback?
real_qa.r: If employees do not feel psychologically safe having a conversation with their boss face to face, throwing an AI chatbot into the system is not necessarily going to help with that. There are two primary psychological mechanisms why someone would withhold feedback: lack of psychological safety and feelings of lack of utility or futility about speaking up, and AI chatbots do not inherently address these root causes.
real_qa.requete: AI chatbot psychological safety employee feedback

real_qa.q: How can organizations use AI to better translate employee feedback for executive action?
real_qa.r: Theory suggests AI can help take basic ideas employees give through surveys, town halls and focus groups and translate them into the language executives use that meets their KPIs and strategic goals. Since employees on the front lines encounter problems but may not have access to strategic goals in the same way leaders do, there is a language translation needed from lower levels to higher levels. If employee ideas are linked back to what executives are already working on, they stand a much better chance for success.
real_qa.requete: AI translate employee feedback executive language
